title: ONE PIECE in Tokyo: The Scroll II and the Mugiwara Store
kicker: Tokyo · A two hour ONE PIECE morning
lead: We meet at Azabudai Hills at 10:30, see The Scroll II when the gallery opens at 11:00, take a taxi to Shibuya for the Mugiwara Store, and finish at 12:30.
subject: ONE PIECE morning
hero_alt: Towers and the green terraces of Azabudai Hills

workshop.lead: Hundred Views of Pirates is a new illustration Eiichiro Oda drew for the 1000th chapter, with the top characters from the 2021 WORLD TOP100 popularity poll. It ran across three issues of Weekly Shonen Jump, and joined side by side it becomes one long picture.
facts: Shueisha Manga-Art Heritage Tokyo Gallery, Azabudai Hills Garden Plaza A, B1. Toranomon 5-8-1, Minato-ku.
Tue to Thu 11:00 to 18:00. Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00 to 19:00. Closed on some days.
steps: Handmade Echizen washi from the Iwano Heisaburo paper mill, founded in 1865. It is Japan's only workshop that makes large sheets by hand.
Collotype, one of the oldest photo printing methods, by Benrido of Kyoto. Each sheet is printed in many colour layers to match the original.
The Scroll II, and a series of ONE PIECE volume covers printed in the same way.
Works can be bought, limited to one of each per person. The gallery's tax-free sales service ends on 1 November 2026.
workshop.note: The gallery opens at 11:00, so we wait outside the doors together and go in first. Please check the gallery's closed-day calendar before the day.
